method: Built-in image generation with selected screenshot as reference; PNG sources preserved unchanged.

photos.maldives-window.png: Portrait 1:2. Wet timber jetty from foreground centre to overwater thatched villas, rope-bound mooring posts, amber lamps, turquoise lagoon, peach-pink and lavender dusk. No text, borders, UI or people.
photos.seychelles-window.png: Portrait 1:2. Rose-grey granite boulders, palms, blue tropical sky, ivory shore at right, crystal turquoise shallows with submerged stones. No text, borders or UI.
photos.dubai-window.png: Portrait 1:2. Marina highrises and architectural crowns, warm window lights, blue-lilac dusk, white yachts and amber/cobalt reflections. No inserted landmarks, text, borders or UI.

leopard: Same upper-right reference pose: calm left-facing three-quarter head and upper chest, golden/amber eye, black nose, golden rosettes, ivory muzzle, fine whiskers, warm upper-left light. Transparent alpha, soft lower and shadow-side edges. Identity/reference reconstruction rather than a guaranteed exact rosette duplicate.
lettering: Clean Archivo font outlines, normal wght 800, italic wght 750, white #ffffff and gold #e4c58d. Leave ordinary. includes an editable native ellipse. Other final SVGs use exact supplied phrases.
